topics.blurb: Retail gasoline price contracts. Kalshi's gas series are sourced from AAA (https://gasprices.aaa.com) per each series' settlement sources.
topics.name: Gas prices
rules: series tag ∈ {Oil and energy | Oil & Gas}

topics.blurb: Election contracts: US and international elections, nominations, and leadership races, matched on Kalshi's official Elections category and tags.
topics.name: Elections
rules: series tag ∈ {US Elections | International elections | Presidential winner | Senate | House | Governor | Primaries | Nomination race | Leadership races | Referendums | Mayors & local | Election Combos}

topics.blurb: Culture & entertainment contracts: Kalshi category `Culture` plus the `Entertainment` and `Mentions` categories that carry pop-culture markets.
topics.name: Culture
rules: series tag ∈ {Music | Awards | Movies | Television | People | Video games | Oscars | Grammys | Collectibles | Critics Choice Awards | Reality TV | Music charts | Art | Food}

topics.blurb: Crypto price and milestone contracts: Kalshi category `Crypto` and its asset tags (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, DOGE, ...).
topics.name: Crypto
rules: series tag ∈ {BTC | ETH | SOL | XRP | DOGE | BNB | HYPE | ZEC | NEAR | Shiba Inu | Crypto | Bitcoin | Ethereum | Solana | Zcash}

topics.blurb: Golf contracts (PGA, DP World Tour, LIV, majors). Kalshi exposes golf as the `Golf` subcategory tag under category `Sports`.
topics.name: Golf

volume_metric_note: est_volume_24h_dollars = volume_24h_fp (contracts, from the API) x last price in dollars. It is an estimate of traded dollars, not a field returned by Kalshi.
